name: OSS_BULK_PROCESSING_ERRORS
description: Subscription DML transactions that cause the backend process to terminate unexpectedly are captured in this table. The information stored here is used to quarantine the affected records within the transaction, allowing the DML operation to proceed while excluding the error records from further processing.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Subscription product identifier in Subscription Management.

columns.description: Product Association identifier in Subscription Management.
